rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasAssessmentFor
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Relates a `from` Vulnerability and each `to` Element with a security assessment. To be used with `VulnAssessmentRelationship` types.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Any specification that does not fall under any of the other entries.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: directory
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The file represents a directory and all content stored in that directory.
Provides a CVSS version 2.0 assessment for a vulnerability.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasOptionalDependency
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element optionally depends on each `to` Element, during a LifecycleScopeType period.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: ecli
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [European Case Law Identifier (ECLI)](https://data.europa.eu/data/datasets/european-case-law-identifier-ecli) is a uniform identifier for judicial decisions across Europe. It consists of five mandatory components: the "ECLI" prefix, a country code, a court code, the year of the decision, and a unique serial number (e.g., `ECLI:EU:C:2023:94`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sha3_224
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SHA-3 with a digest length of 224, as defined in [FIPS 202](https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/fips/202/final).
Energy consumed when finetuning the AI model that is being used in the AI system.
Describes a relationship between one or more elements.
Provides a numerical (0-10) representation of the severity of a vulnerability.
This individual element was defined by the spec.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: query
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Dataset is publicly available, but not all at once, and can only be accessed through queries which return parts of the dataset.
Verification postcondition that are true immediately after a verification method has been performed

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: serious
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The highest level of risk posed by an AI system.

rdf:Description.sh:message: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.1/terms/SupplyChain/ModifyProcess is an abstract class and should not be instantiated directly. Instantiate a subclass instead.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasVariant
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `to` Element is a variant the `from` Element (`from` hasVariant `to`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: amendedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element is amended by each `to` Element.
This is the individual, business, or organization who currently manages goods, services, or assets.
Provides information about the creation of the Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: securityPolicy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to instructions for reporting newly discovered security vulnerabilities for a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: availableFrom
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element is available from the additional supplier described by each `to` Element.
Energy consumed when training the AI model that is being used in the AI system.
EvaluationResult is the result of an evaluation.
A substitute for a URI.
Connects a vulnerability and an element designating the element as a product affected by the vulnerability.

**DEPRECATED in SPDX 3.1.** Use [/Core/endTime](../../Core/Properties/endTime.md) instead.
Property that describes the time at which a build stops.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sourceArtifact
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to an artifact containing the sources for a package.
The name of the recipient expressed in text.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: simpleLicensing
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the SimpleLicensing profile specification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasDistributionArtifact
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element is distributed as an artifact in each `to` Element (e.g. an RPM or archive file).
A mathematically calculated representation of a grouping of data.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: clickthrough
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Dataset is not publicly available and can only be accessed after affirmatively accepting terms on a clickthrough webpage.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: verifiedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Requirement that has verification (test, review, analysis etc.) details defined in the `to` RequirementVerification.
A short description of an Element.
The version of the SPDX License List used in the license expression.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasOptionalComponent
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `to` Element is an optional component of the `from` Element (`from` hasOptionalComponent `to`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: deployed
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SBOM provides an inventory of software that is present on a system. This may be an assembly of other SBOMs that combines analysis of configuration options, and examination of execution behavior in a (potentially simulated) deployment environment.
A collection of Elements that have a shared context.
An Individual Value for License when no assertion can be made about its actual value.
Provides a CVSS version 3 assessment for a vulnerability.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: createdBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element's Action or DefinedProcess is createdBy `to` Agent(s).
An entity that is authorized to issue identification credentials.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: duns
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Data Universal Numbering System (D-U-N-S) Number](https://www.dnb.com/en-us/smb/duns.html) is a unique nine-digit identifier, issued by Dun & Bradstreet, that identifies a business entity, often on a location-specific basis.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: draft
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: in production

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: copiedTo
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has been copied to each `to` Element.
An SPDX Element containing an SPDX license expression string.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sha224
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SHA-2 with a digest length of 224, as defined in [RFC 3874](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc3874/).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: swhid
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SoftWare Hash IDentifier, a persistent intrinsic identifier for digital artifacts, such as files, trees (also known as directories or folders), commits, and other objects typically found in version control systems. The format of the identifiers is defined in the [SWHID specification](https://www.swhid.org/swhid-specification/v1.2/) ([ISO/IEC 18670](https://www.iso.org/standard/89985.html)). They typically look like `swh:1:cnt:94a9ed024d3859793618152ea559a168bbcbb5e2`.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: inconclusive
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Inconclusive refers to a result or outcome from a verification, test, or analysis that cannot be clearly classified as either positive (successful, pass) or negative (failed, reject). An inconclusive result means there was not enough clear evidence, data, or signal to make a definitive determination, and further investigation or additional testing is necessary. An inconclusive result always shall need a comment on it.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: affects
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Vulnerability, Action or DefinedProcess affects each `to` Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: releaseHistory
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a published list of releases for a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: device
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element refers to a chipset, processor, or electronic board.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: cpe23
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Common Platform Enumeration: Naming Specification Version 2.3](https://csrc.nist.gov/publications/detail/nistir/7695/final).
Provides an SSVC assessment for a vulnerability.
A verificationUUID is a universally unique identifier (UUID) assigned to a Verification item.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: implementedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Requirement is implemented in the `to` Element(s).
A transport route refers to the specific path or network used to move people, goods, data, or resources from one location to another.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: analysis
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Analytical evaluating of data, designs, or processes methodically to verify correctness against standards or expectations. Typical analysis methods are FMEA, FTA, STPA, static analysis for MISRA compliance etc.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: directDownload
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Dataset is publicly available and can be downloaded directly.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: audit
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An examination typically focusing on compliance with policies, standards, or regulations. Usually this is done during an audit meeting, while the assessment also involves deep and detailed reviews of work products (e.g. requirements, verification specifications, reports etc.)

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: graph
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data is in the form of a graph where entries are somehow related to each other through edges, such a social network of friends.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relationship has other specific context information necessary to capture that the above set of enumerations does not handle.
This is the state of an affected Element at a specific moment in time.
Class that describes an instance of Hardware.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: ancestorOf
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element is an ancestor of each `to` Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: exploitCreatedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Vulnerability has had an exploit created against it by each `to` Agent.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: md5
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: MD5 message-digest algorithm, as defined in [RFC 1321](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc1321/).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Other exploit catalogs.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: categorical
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data that is classified into a discrete number of categories, such as the eye color of a population of people.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: runtime
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relationship has specific context implications during the execution phase of an element.
A string in the license expression format.
The boundary definition is used to define boundaries.
Owner or Lead of the project.

rdf:Description.sh:message: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.1/terms/Hardware/Hardware is an abstract class and should not be instantiated directly. Instantiate a subclass instead.

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element that has it's responsibility changed.
A test action is a specific action associated with a test.
Artifact representing a serialization instance of SPDX data containing the definition of a particular Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: bower
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a Bower package. The package locator format, looks like `package#version`, is defined in the "install" section of [Bower API documentation](https://bower.io/docs/api/#install).
A distinct article or unit related to Software.
Identify the version of a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasStaticLink
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element statically links in each `to` Element, during a LifecycleScopeType period.
Contains a URL where the License or LicenseAddition can be found in use.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasProvidedDependency
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has a dependency on each `to` Element, dependency is not in the distributed artifact, but assumed to be provided, during a LifecycleScopeType period.
Specifies the algorithm used for calculating the hash value.
The Agent who is responsible for product branding such as an OEM.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: incomplete
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relationship is known not to be exhaustive.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: urlScheme
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) Schemes](https://www.iana.org/assignments/uri-schemes/uri-schemes.xhtml). The scheme used in order to locate a resource.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: critical
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: When a CVSS score is between 9.0 - 10.0.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: configures
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element is a configuration applied to each `to` Element, during a LifecycleScopeType period.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: providesSupportFor
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Agent provides support for each `to` Artifact. Shall be a `SupportRelationship` type.
Dimensions generally refer to measurable extents or attributes that define the size, shape, or scale of an object, system, or concept.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Any other specialized or custom verification method that fits the context.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: finetunedOn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has been finetuned on the `to` Element(s).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: diskImage
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element refers to a disk image that can be written to a disk, booted in a VM, etc. A disk image typically contains most or all of the components necessary to boot, such as bootloaders, kernels, firmware, userspace, etc.
Maps a "LicenseRef-" string for a custom license or a "AdditionRef-" string for a custom license addition to a `CustomLicense`, a `CustomLicenseAddition`, or a `SimpleLicensingText`.
Energy consumption incurred by an AI model.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: vulnerableCodeCannotBeControlledByAdversary
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The vulnerable component is present, and the component contains the vulnerable code. However, vulnerable code is used in such a way that an attacker cannot mount any anticipated attack.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: text
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data consists of unstructured text, such as a book, a Wikipedia article (without images), or a transcript.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: structured
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data is stored in tabular format or retrieved from a relational database.
An out of specification action is defined in this class.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: generates
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element generates each `to` Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: firmware
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element provides low level control over a device's hardware.
An Individual Value for Element representing a set of Elements of unknown identity or cardinality (number).
An individual human being.
Specifies the time when a vulnerability was published.
Identifies the full text of a License or Addition.
A LicenseAddition participating in a 'with addition' model.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: vulnerableCodeNotInExecutePath
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The affected code is not reachable through the execution of the code, including non-anticipated states of the product.
The location for picking up a package or item.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: crystalsDilithium
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Dilithium](https://pq-crystals.org/dilithium/)

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: metrics
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to metrics related to package such as OpenSSF scorecards.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: license
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to additional license information related to an artifact.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: md6
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [MD6 hash function](https://people.csail.mit.edu/rivest/pubs/RABCx08.pdf)
A distinct unit representing a requirement, as used in systems, software, and hardware engineering.
Identifies the size of a software Artifact, in bytes.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: runsOn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element (the instructions) of runs on each `to` Hardware (processing element), during a LifecycleScopeType period.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: eolNotice
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to the End Of Sale (EOS) and/or End Of Life (EOL) information related to a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: configuration
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is configuration data.
References the Element on the left-hand side of a relationship.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: bom
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a bill of materials.
Portion of an AnyLicenseInfo representing this version, or any later version, of the indicated License.
Specifies an Element contained in a piece of software where a vulnerability was found.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: socialMedia
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a social media channel for a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: file
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The file represents a single file (default).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: crystalsKyber
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Kyber](https://pq-crystals.org/kyber/)

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An authentication protocol not covered by one of the other AuthenticationProtocolTypes.
An actual change to a product.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: vulnerableCodeNotPresent
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The product is not affected because the code underlying the vulnerability is not present in the product.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: image
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data is a collection of images such as pictures of animals.

**DEPRECATED in SPDX 3.1.** Use [/Core/intendedUse](../../Core/Properties/intendedUse.md) instead.
The intended use of a given dataset.

rdf:Description.sh:message: Class is known to not derive from Extension and cannot be used

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: source
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SBOM created directly from the development environment, source files, and included dependencies used to build a product artifact.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: blake2b384
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: BLAKE2b algorithm with a digest size of 384, as defined in [RFC 7693](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc7693/) Section 4.
Quantity is the amount in the selected QUDT unit.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: executable
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is an Artifact that can be run on a computer.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasSpecification
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `to` Element is a specification for the `from` Element (`from` hasSpecification `to`), during a LifecycleScopeType period.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: coordinatedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Vulnerability is coordinatedBy the `to` Agent(s) (vendor, researcher, or consumer agent).
Additional relevance information.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: framework
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a software framework.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: support
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A contact point for support.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: lexid
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: LEX Identifier is a Uniform Resource Name (URN) for sources of law within the [LEX namespace](https://www.iana.org/assignments/urn-formal/lex), as defined in [RFC 9676](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc9676/) (e.g., `urn:lex:it:stato:decreto.legislativo:2018-08-10;101`).
Safety risk level.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: notAutomated
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Level 0 - Not automated. No automation. The operator fully controls the system.
A concrete subclass of Element used by Individuals in the Core profile.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sha3_512
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SHA-3 with a digest length of 512, as defined in [FIPS 202](https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/fips/202/final).

rdf:Description.sh:message: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.1/terms/Core/Artifact is an abstract class and should not be instantiated directly. Instantiate a subclass instead.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: productMetadata
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to additional product metadata such as reference within organization's product catalog.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: ark
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Archival Resource Key (ARK)](https://arks.org/about/), is a Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) suited to being a persistent identifier for information objects of any type, standardized by the [ARK Identifier Scheme](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/draft-kunze-ark/) Internet-Draft. It consists of the "ark:" label followed by a Name Assigning Authority Number, a forward slash, a name, and an optional qualifier (e.g., `ark:12148/btv1b8449691v/f29`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: module
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a module of a piece of software.

rdf:Description.sh:message: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.1/terms/ExpandedLicensing/LicenseAddition is an abstract class and should not be instantiated directly. Instantiate a subclass instead.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: vulnerabilityDisclosureReport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a Vulnerability Disclosure Report (VDR) which provides the software supplier's analysis and findings describing the impact (or lack of impact) that reported vulnerabilities have on packages or products in the supplier's SBOM as defined in [NIST SP 800-161 Cybersecurity Supply Chain Risk Management Practices for Systems and Organizations](https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/sp/800/161/r1/final).
The percentile of the current probability score.
An actual alteration of a product.
The ProcessReadinessType is defined by the enumeration.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: recording
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Captured datastream like audio, video, or any other kind of continuous electronic capture of events, behavior or conditions.
Specifies until when the artifact can be used before its usage needs to be reassessed.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Any other units of energy measurement.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: fail
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Indicates a failed evaluation where the requirement or condition is not met.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: delegatedTo
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Agent is delegating an action to the Agent of the `to` Relationship (which shall be of type invokedBy), during a LifecycleScopeType (e.g. the `to` invokedBy Relationship is being done on behalf of `from`).
This is the planned individual, business, or organization who currently manages goods, services, or assets.

rdf:Description.sh:message: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.1/terms/Extension/Extension is an abstract class and should not be instantiated directly. Instantiate a subclass instead.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: software
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the Software profile specification.
Refers to any unit of content that can be associated with a distribution of software.
Records the biases that the dataset is known to encompass.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: megajoule
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Megajoule.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: partialAutomation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Level 2 - Partial automation or task automation. Some sub-functions of the system are fully automated while the system remain under control of an external agent. The system can perform actions for an approved task without requiring the agent's continuous direct control.
Specification basis for the export control classification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: doi
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Digital Object Identifier (DOI)](https://www.doi.org/the-identifier/what-is-a-doi/) is a unique, [ISO 26324](https://www.iso.org/standard/88862.html)-standardized identifier for physical, digital, or abstract objects, formatted as a prefix and suffix separated by a forward slash (e.g., `10.1000/182`).
A group of people who work together in an organized way for a shared purpose.
Provides information about the primary purpose of the software artifact.
A canonical, unique, immutable identifier.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: active
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: in use
A class for describing the energy consumption incurred by an AI model in different stages of its lifecycle.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: funding
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to funding information related to a package.
ResponsibilityChangeProcess refers to the process of transferring responsibility from one party to another.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: security
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the Security profile specification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: operatingSystem
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is an operating system.
The CreateProcess refers to the abstract process class that can be used to represent the process of creation of a product.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: noSupport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: There is no support for the artifact from the supplier, consumer assumes any support obligations.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: packageUrl
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Package URL, as defined in the corresponding [Annex](../../../annexes/pkg-url-specification.md) of this document.
The planned location that a good, product or material is stored.
Version identifier for the hardware product.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: modifiedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element is modified by each `to` Element.
The category describes the hardware item in a DefinedType.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: demonstration
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Demonstrating and monitoring or recording that the item under verification to confirm that a requirement is met by the item under verification.
It is the authoritative or credible entity, document, or body of knowledge that provides the meaning of a type, ensuring accuracy, context, and standardization.
Class that describes an action that has occurred.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sha1
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SHA-1, a secure hashing algorithm, as defined in [RFC 3174](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc3174/).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: scrapingScript
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Dataset provider is not making available the underlying data and the dataset shall be reassembled, typically using the provided script for scraping the data.
An Element an annotator has made an assertion about.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: low
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: When a CVSS score is between 0.1 - 3.9.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasRequirement
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has a requirement on each `to` Element, during a LifecycleScopeType period.
Availability of dataset.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: mailingList
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to the mailing list used by the maintainer for a package.
Date of product release.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: vcs
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a version control system related to a software artifact.
A map of Element identifiers that are used within an SpdxDocument but defined external to that SpdxDocument.
Defines the beginning of a range.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: purchaseOrder
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a purchase order for a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasDynamicLink
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element dynamically links in each `to` Element, during a LifecycleScopeType period.
Provides a universally unique Requirement ID.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: design
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relationship has specific context implications during an element's design.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: review
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A examination or checking of documentation, records, processes, or systems to confirm compliance or adherence with an upper level requirement. Typically done as peer review, offline review or review meeting.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: pretrainedOn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has been pretrained on the `to` Element(s).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: specification
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A specification is a detailed document (or set of documents) that describes the requirements, design, behavior, or other characteristics of a system, component, or process so that all stakeholders have a clear, unambiguous reference.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: lei
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The [Legal Entity Identifier (LEI)](https://www.gleif.org/en/organizational-identity/introducing-the-legal-entity-identifier-lei) is a 20-character, alphanumeric code based on the [ISO 17442](https://www.iso.org/standard/78829.html) standard developed by the International Organization for Standardization.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: foundBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Designates a `from` Vulnerability was originally discovered by the `to` Agent(s).

rdf:Description.sh:message: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.1/terms/Security/VulnAssessmentRelationship is an abstract class and should not be instantiated directly. Instantiate a subclass instead.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: cycle
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Simulation architectures with precise cycle-level accuracy.
Identifies the nature of the contactPointRelationship.
Confidentiality level of the data points contained in the dataset.
Reproduction is the biological process by which organisms generate new individuals of the same species.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: video
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data is video based, such as a collection of movie clips featuring Tom Hanks.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: securityThreatModel
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to the [security threat model](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Threat_model) for a package.
The relative file name of a file to be excluded from the `PackageVerificationCode`.
Test Process defines the testing process for an element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: isbn

A 13-digit ISBN is composed of five parts: a GS1 prefix, a registration group, a registrant, a publication element, and a check digit. While elements may be divided by spaces or hyphens for human readability, these separators shall be omitted when the identifier is stored electronically (e.g., `9780198836063`).
